description: Pfam HMM census of polyamine-pathway families across the B. thetaiotaomicron proteome, saved as a provenance table
code:
import requests, os, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=proteome:UP000001414"
     "&format=tsv&fields=accession,gene_primary,protein_name,xref_pfam,length")
txt=S.get(url,timeout=900).text
lines=[l for l in txt.split("\n") if l.strip()]
hdr=lines[0].split("\t"); recs=[dict(zip(hdr,l.split("\t"))) for l in lines[1:]]
print(f"proteome entries parsed: {len(recs)}")

PF={"PF00491":"Arginase/agmatinase/ureohydrolase","PF01276":"Orn/Lys/Arg decarboxylase major domain",
    "PF03709":"Orn/Lys/Arg decarboxylase N-terminal","PF03711":"Orn/Lys/Arg decarboxylase C-terminal",
    "PF00282":"Pyridoxal-dependent decarboxylase group II (Ddc/DABA-DC family)",
    "PF00202":"Aminotransferase class-III (EctB/DABA-AT family)",
    "PF01564":"Spermine/spermidine synthase (SpeE)","PF01536":"S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase (SpeD)",
    "PF02784":"Orn/DAP/Arg decarboxylase PLP-binding barrel","PF00278":"Orn/DAP/Arg decarboxylase C-terminal",
    "PF03435":"Saccharopine dehydrogenase NADP-binding","PF16653":"Saccharopine dehydrogenase C-terminal"}
rows=[]
for pf,desc in PF.items():
    hits=[r for r in recs if pf in (r.get("Pfam") or "")]
    mem="; ".join(f"{(r.get('Gene Names (primary)') or r['Entry'])}" for r in hits) or "NONE"
    det="; ".join(f"{(r.get('Gene Names (primary)') or r['Entry'])} [{r['Entry']}] {r.get('Protein names','')[:60]}" for r in hits) or "NONE"
    rows.append({"pfam":pf,"family":desc,"count":len(hits),"members":mem,"detail":det})
    print(f"{pf}  n={len(hits):2d}  {desc[:46]:46s} -> {det[:95]}")
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv("provenance/bt4612_pfam_census.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved provenance/bt4612_pfam_census.csv")

order=["PF01276","PF03709","PF03711","PF01564","PF01536","PF00491","PF03435","PF16653","PF00282","PF00202"]
lab={"PF01276":"ODC/LDC major\n(fold III)","PF03709":"ODC/LDC N-term","PF03711":"ODC/LDC C-term",
     "PF01564":"SpeE spermidine\nsynthase","PF01536":"SpeD AdoMetDC","PF00491":"ureohydrolase\n(BT_1099)",
     "PF03435":"SacDH NADP-bind\n(BT_4612)","PF16653":"SacDH C-term\n(BT_4612)",
     "PF00282":"grp II PLP decarb\n(GAD only)","PF00202":"class-III AT\n(BioA, AcOrn-AT)"}
cnt=[int(df.set_index('pfam').loc[p,'count']) for p in order]
col=["#c44e52" if c==0 else ("#dd8452" if p in ("PF00282","PF00202") else "#4c72b0") for p,c in zip(order,cnt)]
plt.figure(figsize=(12,4.4))
plt.bar(range(len(order)),cnt,color=col)
for i,c in enumerate(cnt): plt.text(i,c+0.04,str(c),ha="center",fontsize=10)
plt.xticks(range(len(order)),[lab[p] for p in order],fontsize=8)
plt.ylabel("members in proteome UP000001414\n(4,782 entries)")
plt.title("Pfam HMM census: red = family-level zero (firm absence), orange = family present but no member annotated to the activity")
plt.ylim(0,2.6); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
